newsitem.title: USA: Digital Descriptor delisted from NASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: Digital Descriptor delisted from NASDAQ.

text.p: Digital Descriptor Systems Inc said Tuesday its shares were delisted from NASDAQ at the close of business on July 7.
The company said it did not meet the $2 million total asset and $1 million capital surplus requirement.
The company said total assets at December 31, 1996 were $1.9 million and capital and surplus were $1.1 respectively.
The company said NASDAQ excluded from assets a $150,000 certificate of deposit pledged for a bank loan, which has now been reduced to $82,000.
The company said it is in discussion with several investment banking firms for private placement of capital.
It said it will "make every effort" to meet NASDAQ requirements and will apply for listing as soon as possible.
